result: Full test of 5.7.10 on portable VS Code 1.144.0 (the 2026-10-28 row was a smoke test). Two findings: (1) liveServer.settings.host does not touch the listening socket - Helper.generateParams hardcodes host '0.0.0.0' and Config.getHost is used only for the browser URL - so with host 127.0.0.1 the server still listens on 0.0.0.0:5501 (netstat, extension-host pid) and is reachable from the LAN; already open upstream as #3091 (created 2025-03-02, no comments), so not filed; (2) the cors description promises Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * but the live-server middleware is cors({origin:true, credentials:true}): no ACAO without an Origin, and Origin: http://example.com is echoed with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true - filed https://github.com/ritwickdey/vscode-live-server/issues/3334. Correct as documented: static serving with text/html, text/css and image/svg+xml types plus charset; 404 body Cannot GET <path>; the reload script is injected into HTML (case-insensitive extension) and into SVG (live-server's own injectCandidates include </svg>), never into CSS or plain text; directory index (index.html) and serve-index listing otherwise (ws_client3.js listed); URL-encoded space, non-ASCII café, query string, HEAD (CL set, no body), Range bytes=0-9 -> 206 with Content-Range, If-None-Match -> 304; ../../../ gets 403 and root=/ls_probe/sub confines serving (outside path 404); mount [['/mnt','ls_probe/css']] serves the css at /mnt/style.css; file 'spa.html' is a 404-only fallback mounted after the static handler (missing path -> 200 spa content, real css still served); headers object adds X-Probe and Cache-Control verbatim; ignoreFiles ['**/*.css'] suppresses the css change while the html change still reloads; fullReload true turns a css change into a full 'reload' instead of 'refreshcss'; live reload verified with a websocket client (connected, reload on html, refreshcss on css, full reload on css with fullReload); port fallback works but takes about 6 s and bumps by +1 (9560 taken -> setting 9561, 445 -> 446), not the "random port" the 5.6.0 changelog promises; goOffline really closes the socket (ECONNREFUSED 1.5 s later); a stop followed by a start needs about 1.2 s (StopServer has an internal 1000 ms wait) or the start is lost. Not tested: https (no certificate), CustomBrowser/AdvanceCustomBrowserCmdLine/ChromeDebuggingAttachment (they spawn external browsers), changeWorkspace (quick pick), useLocalIp (affects the browser URL only; see #3304), showOnStatusbar (status bar text is not readable through the API), the wait debounce (timing-only effect), Live Share integration, multi-root workspaces (no API to add a folder).

prettier.disableLanguages is declared but never read, so it has no effect: https://github.com/prettier/prettier-vscode/issues/4015. Format Selection formats the whole file when the selection starts at offset 0 (rangeStart 0 is falsy in 'rangeEnd && rangeStart'): commented with the cause on the open issue https://github.com/prettier/prettier-vscode/issues/3567

Full test of 0.12.2 on portable VS Code 1.144.0 (the 2026-10-28 row was a smoke test). Five defects, all cause-read: (1) $fileNameWithoutExt returns the FULL ABSOLUTE PATH for a file with no extension (getCodeFileWithoutDirAndExt's regex /.*[\/\\](.*(?=\..*))/ needs a dot; verified live: probe_noext -> c:\Users\donal\tools\vscode_portable\work\cr_probe\probe_noext, documented value is the base name); (2) $workspaceRoot resolves to the code file's directory instead of the workspace folder on the first run after activation when code-runner.cwd is set (initialize() returns at the cwd check before _workspaceFolder is computed, and getWorkspaceRoot falls back to codeFileDir; verified after a reload: c:\...\cr_probe\ while the folder is c:\...\work, and it silently becomes the right value after any earlier run without cwd); (3) $dir is quoted WITH its trailing backslash ("...\cr_probe\"), so on Windows every argument after it merges into one token - receipt argv showed `D:c:\...\cr_probe" DT:... F:... N:... NE:... DL:c:` as a single argument (quoted backslash before the closing quote escapes it in CommandLineToArgvW); any native executor using `$dir <something>` is affected; (4) a selection run with runInTerminal true leaves tempCodeRunnerFile.js in the source folder (fs.unlinkSync lives only in the output-channel close handler; 126-byte file left behind after the run); (5) code-runner.stop does nothing in terminal mode (_isRunning is set only in executeCommandInOutputChannel, so stopRunning() no-ops; the heartbeat file kept growing 25 -> 33 lines after the stop). Correct as documented: default run of the active file (node, cwd = workspace root without fileDirectoryAsCwd, [Running] command / [Done] code and seconds in the Code output channel), cwd rules 1-3 (code-runner.cwd, fileDirectoryAsCwd, workspace root), executorMapByGlob (overrides the language map, exact basename and *.js), defaultLanguage fallback for a language with no executor, respectShebang true (#!node) and false (falls through to defaultLanguage), the other placeholders ($fileName, $fullFileName, $dirWithoutTrailingSlash, $driveLetter, dotted basename a.b.js -> a.b), temporaryFileName + languageIdToFileExtensionMap (probeTmp.probe, deleted after an output-channel run), ignoreSelection (whole file, no temp file), saveFileBeforeRun and saveAllFilesBeforeRun (disk verified), clearPreviousOutput, runInTerminal (terminal named Code, correct cwd, program output in the terminal) and executorMapByFileExtension (consulted only when the language has no executor; fires for plaintext .txt; the shipped default object already maps .vbs -> cscript //Nologo, and a user executorMap object REPLACES the shipped defaults rather than merging). Not tested: Run By Language quick pick, the show* menu settings, preserveFocus, showExecutionMessage=false, app insights. RECORD ONLY, nothing filed: upstream formulahendry/vscode-code-runner is dormant (last commit 2024-04-05, not archived, 757 open issues).

Full test of 0.0.3 on portable VS Code 1.144.0 (the 2026-10-28 row was a smoke test). The whole extension is one JSON.parse + JSON.stringify(obj, null, 4) whole-document replace (out/src/extension.js); the README promises only "prettify ugly JSON". RECORD ONLY, nothing filed: upstream mohsen1/vscode-prettify-json is dormant (last push 2019-06-10). Findings, all verified live: (1) the round trip is lossy and corrupts values silently - 9007199254740993 becomes 9007199254740992 (already open upstream as issue 8, 2019-07-09), and the same JSON.parse/stringify class also collapses duplicate keys ({"a":1,"a":2} becomes {"a": 2}), turns -0 into 0, and turns the valid JSON number 1e999 (Infinity in JS) into null; (2) invalid JSON is a silent no-op - nothing shown, nothing logged (TODO comment sits in the code). Correct as documented: pretty output is exactly JSON.stringify(..., null, 4) (four spaces, escapes decoded to literal characters, 1e10 becomes 10000000000, -0.5 kept), scalar roots round-trip (true), a CRLF document keeps CRLF (VS Code normalises the inserted \n to the document EOL), activation on the command works. Indentation is hard-coded at 4 (upstream issue 14 open, issue 4 closed). No settings; one command.
